refresh_minutes.label: Refresh interval
refresh_minutes.description: How often prices are refetched from the Tibber API. Failed requests are retried after 60 seconds.

price_unit.label: Price unit
price_unit.description: Minor shows e.g. 23 ct/kWh (EUR) or 230 öre/kWh (SEK), major shows e.g. 0.23 EUR/kWh.

show_unit.label: Show unit
show_unit.description: Append the unit (ct, EUR, ...) to prices in the bar, panel and desktop widget.

glyph.label: Bar glyph
glyph.description: Glyph shown next to the current price in the bar widget.

color.label: Chart color
color.description: Color of the sparkline in the desktop widget.

show_chart.label: Show price chart

show_minmax.label: Show cheapest / most expensive
